371: #===============================================================================
372: # Pokémon is asleep, won't wake up soon and can't do anything while asleep.
373: #===============================================================================
374: Battle::AI::Handlers::ShouldSwitch.add(:asleep,
375:   proc { |battler, reserves, ai, battle|
376:     # Asleep and won't wake up this round or next round
377:     next false if battler.status != :SLEEP || battler.statusCount <= 2
378:     # Doesn't want to be asleep (includes checking for moves usable while asleep)
379:     next false if battler.wants_status_problem?(:SLEEP)
380:     # Doesn't benefit from being asleep
381:     next false if battler.has_active_ability?(:MARVELSCALE)
382:     # Doesn't know Rest (if it does, sleep is expected, so don't apply this check)
383:     next false if battler.check_for_move { |m| m.function_code == "HealUserFullyAndFallAsleep" }
384:     # Not trapping another battler in battle
385:     if ai.trainer.high_skill?
386:       next false if ai.battlers.any? do |b|
387:         b.effects[PBEffects::JawLock] == battler.index ||
388:         b.effects[PBEffects::MeanLook] == battler.index ||
389:         b.effects[PBEffects::Octolock] == battler.index ||
390:         b.effects[PBEffects::TrappingUser] == battler.index
391:       end
392:       trapping = false
393:       ai.each_foe_battler(battler.side) do |b, i|
394:         next if b.ability_active? && Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerCertainSwitching(b.ability, b.battler, battle)
395:         next if b.item_active? && Battle::ItemEffects.triggerCertainSwitching(b.item, b.battler, battle)
396:         next if Settings::MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS && b.has_type?(:GHOST)
397:         next if b.battler.trappedInBattle?   # Relevant trapping effects are checked above
398:         if battler.ability_active?
399:           trapping = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerTrappingByTarget(battler.ability, b.battler, battler.battler, battle)
400:           break if trapping
401:         end
402:         if battler.item_active?
403:           trapping = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerTrappingByTarget(battler.item, b.battler, battler.battler, battle)
404:           break if trapping
405:         end
406:       end
407:       next false if trapping
408:     end
409:     # Doesn't have sufficiently raised stats that would be lost by switching
410:     next false if battler.stages.any? { |key, val| val >= 2 }
411:     # A reserve Pokémon is awake and not frozen
412:     next false if reserves.none? { |pkmn| ![:SLEEP, :FROZEN].include?(pkmn.status) }
413:     # 60% chance to not bother
414:     next false if ai.pbAIRandom(100) < 60
415:     PBDebug.log_ai("#{battler.name} wants to switch because it is asleep and can't do anything")
416:     next true
417:   }
418: )

421: # Pokémon can't use any moves and isn't Destiny Bonding/Grudging/hiding behind a
422: # Substitute.
423: #===============================================================================
424: Battle::AI::Handlers::ShouldSwitch.add(:battler_is_useless,
425:   proc { |battler, reserves, ai, battle|
426:     next false if !ai.trainer.medium_skill?
427:     next false if battler.turnCount < 2   # Just switched in, give it a chance
428:     next false if battle.pbCanChooseAnyMove?(battler.index)
429:     next false if battler.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBond] || battler.effects[PBEffects::Grudge]
430:     if battler.effects[PBEffects::Substitute]
431:       hidden_behind_substitute = true
432:       ai.each_foe_battler(battler.side) do |b, i|
433:         next if !b.check_for_move { |m| m.ignoresSubstitute?(b.battler) }
434:         hidden_behind_substitute = false
435:         break
436:       end
437:       next false if hidden_behind_substitute
438:     end
439:     PBDebug.log_ai("#{battler.name} wants to switch because it can't do anything")
440:     next true
441:   }

444: #===============================================================================
445: # Pokémon can't do anything to any foe because its ability absorbs all damage
446: # the Pokémon can deal out.
447: #===============================================================================
448: Battle::AI::Handlers::ShouldSwitch.add(:foe_absorbs_all_moves_with_its_ability,
449:   proc { |battler, reserves, ai, battle|
450:     next false if battler.battler.turnCount < 2   # Don't switch out too quickly
451:     next false if battler.battler.hasMoldBreaker?
452:     # Check if battler can damage any of its foes
453:     can_damage_foe = false
454:     ai.each_foe_battler(battler.side) do |b, i|
455:       if ai.trainer.high_skill? && b.rough_end_of_round_damage > 0
456:         can_damage_foe = true   # Foe is being damaged already
457:         break
458:       end
459:       # Check for battler's moves that can damage the foe (b)
460:       battler.battler.eachMove do |move|
461:         next if move.statusMove?
462:         if ["IgnoreTargetAbility",
463:             "CategoryDependsOnHigherDamageIgnoreTargetAbility"].include?(move.function_code)
464:           can_damage_foe = true
465:           break
466:         end
467:         if !ai.pokemon_can_absorb_move?(b, move, move.pbCalcType(battler.battler))
468:           can_damage_foe = true
469:           break
470:         end
471:       end
472:       break if can_damage_foe
473:     end
474:     next false if can_damage_foe
475:     # Check if a reserve could damage any foe; only switch if one could
476:     reserve_can_damage_foe = false
477:     reserves.each do |pkmn|
478:       ai.each_foe_battler(battler.side) do |b, i|
479:         # Check for reserve's moves that can damage the foe (b)
480:         pkmn.moves.each do |move|
481:           next if move.status_move?
482:           if ["IgnoreTargetAbility",
483:               "CategoryDependsOnHigherDamageIgnoreTargetAbility"].include?(move.function_code)
484:             reserve_can_damage_foe = true
485:             break
486:           end
487:           if !ai.pokemon_can_absorb_move?(b, move, move.type)
488:             reserve_can_damage_foe = true
489:             break
490:           end
491:         end
492:         break if reserve_can_damage_foe
493:       end
494:       break if reserve_can_damage_foe
495:     end
496:     next false if !reserve_can_damage_foe
497:     PBDebug.log_ai("#{battler.name} wants to switch because it can't damage the foe(s)")
498:     next true
499:   }
500: )

502: #===============================================================================
503: # Pokémon doesn't have an ability that makes it immune to a foe's move, but a
504: # reserve does (see def pokemon_can_absorb_move?). The foe's move is chosen
505: # randomly, or is their most powerful move if the trainer's skill level is good
506: # enough.
507: #===============================================================================
508: Battle::AI::Handlers::ShouldSwitch.add(:absorb_foe_move,
509:   proc { |battler, reserves, ai, battle|
510:     next false if !ai.trainer.medium_skill?
511:     # Not worth it if the battler is evasive enough
512:     next false if battler.stages[:EVASION] >= 3
513:     # Not worth it if abilities are being negated
514:     next false if battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS)
515:     # Get the foe move with the highest power (or a random damaging move)
516:     foe_moves = []
517:     ai.each_foe_battler(battler.side) do |b, i|
518:       b.moves.each do |move|
519:         next if move.statusMove?
520:         m_power = move.power
521:         m_power = 100 if move.is_a?(Battle::Move::OHKO)
522:         m_type = move.pbCalcType(b.battler)
523:         foe_moves.push([m_power, m_type, move])
524:       end
525:     end
526:     next false if foe_moves.empty?
527:     if ai.trainer.high_skill?
528:       foe_moves.sort! { |a, b| a[0] <=> b[0] }   # Highest power move
529:       chosen_move = foe_moves.last
530:     else
531:       chosen_move = foe_moves[ai.pbAIRandom(foe_moves.length)]   # Random move
532:     end
533:     # Get the chosen move's information
534:     move_power = chosen_move[0]
535:     move_type = chosen_move[1]
536:     move = chosen_move[2]
537:     # Don't bother if the foe's best move isn't too strong
538:     next false if move_power < 70
539:     # Check battler for absorbing ability
540:     next false if ai.pokemon_can_absorb_move?(battler, move, move_type)
541:     # battler can't absorb move; find a party Pokémon that can
542:     if reserves.any? { |pkmn| ai.pokemon_can_absorb_move?(pkmn, move, move_type) }
543:       next false if ai.pbAIRandom(100) < 70
544:       PBDebug.log_ai("#{battler.name} wants to switch because it can't absorb a foe's move but a reserve can")
545:       next true
546:     end
547:     next false
548:   }
549: )

551: #===============================================================================
552: # Sudden Death rule (at the end of each round, if one side has more able Pokémon
553: # than the other side, that side wins). Avoid fainting at all costs.
554: # NOTE: This rule isn't used anywhere.
555: #===============================================================================
556: Battle::AI::Handlers::ShouldSwitch.add(:sudden_death,
557:   proc { |battler, reserves, ai, battle|
558:     next false if !battle.rules["suddendeath"] || battler.turnCount == 0
559:     if battler.hp <= battler.totalhp / 2
560:       threshold = 100 * (battler.totalhp - battler.hp) / battler.totalhp
561:       if ai.pbAIRandom(100) < threshold
562:         PBDebug.log_ai("#{battler.name} wants to switch to avoid being KO'd and losing because of the sudden death rule")
563:         next true
564:       end
565:     end
566:     next false
567:   }
568: )

570: #===============================================================================
571: # Pokémon is within 5 levels of the foe, and foe's last move was super-effective
572: # and powerful.
573: #===============================================================================
574: Battle::AI::Handlers::ShouldSwitch.add(:high_damage_from_foe,
575:   proc { |battler, reserves, ai, battle|
576:     next false if !ai.trainer.high_skill?
577:     next false if battler.hp >= battler.totalhp / 2
578:     big_threat = false
579:     ai.each_foe_battler(battler.side) do |b, i|
580:       next if (b.level - battler.level).abs > 5
581:       next if !b.battler.lastMoveUsed || !GameData::Move.exists?(b.battler.lastMoveUsed)
582:       move_data = GameData::Move.get(b.battler.lastMoveUsed)
583:       next if move_data.status?
584:       eff = battler.effectiveness_of_type_against_battler(move_data.type, b)
585:       next if !Effectiveness.super_effective?(eff) || move_data.power < 70
586:       switch_chance = (move_data.power > 90) ? 50 : 25
587:       big_threat = (ai.pbAIRandom(100) < switch_chance)
588:       break if big_threat
589:     end
590:     if big_threat
591:       PBDebug.log_ai("#{battler.name} wants to switch because a foe has a powerful super-effective move")
592:       next true
593:     end
594:     next false
595:   }

633: Battle::AI::Handlers::ShouldNotSwitch.add(:battler_has_super_effective_move,

641:       next if move.statusMove?
642:       # NOTE: Ideally this would ignore moves that are unusable, but that would
643:       #       be too complicated to implement.
